mintAuthority.summary: BUCK is Bucket Protocol's legacy Sui stablecoin. At checkpoint 336266194 the shared protocol retains its TreasuryCap, while both AdminCaps and the policy-0, version-27 UpgradeCap are address-owned by 0x19f528cf4b5d0d8bcbc33c66405d149ea726a4dc1bc773537dc65364d4e58be4. Signing policy is unresolved. Known cap-raising and unrestricted mint-logic upgrade powers remain economically unbounded.

controls.label: BucketProtocol shared object holding BUCK TreasuryCap
controls.capDescription: BUCK TreasuryCap is wrapped inside the shared BucketProtocol object; the object itself cannot raise a mint bound. A separately held AdminCap can call update_max_mint_amount, and the package UpgradeCap can change the mint-critical code.

review.evidence: Current native-control identity reviewed at checkpoint 336266194 (2026-10-20T22:19:11.887Z). The shared protocol retains its exact BUCK TreasuryCap. Both AdminCaps and the unrestricted policy-0, version-27 package UpgradeCap now belong to the same address 0x19f528cf4b5d0d8bcbc33c66405d149ea726a4dc1bc773537dc65364d4e58be4; the prior separate owners remain historical observations, not current controllers. Existing cap-raising and mint-logic-replacement economics stay unbounded. The current address's signing policy and custody were not established, so EOA and quorum claims are not carried forward. This ownership review supplies no reserve reconciliation, executable liquidation capacity or source-equivalence proof.
